data_fields.name: ammo_cap_per_type
data_fields.donor_constant: max_<ammo> spawn arg, default 0 (value in .def data, not read)

data_fields.name: armour_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: maxarmor (value from spawn data, not read)

data_fields.name: toast_rest_after_set
data_fields.donor_constant: 2000 (anchored on onePickupTime, which is never set)

best_idea: A pickup is refused whole-or-part when the store has no room, the item stays in the world, and the pickup toast queue is paced in one place.
decision_why: Refuse-when-full and the cap clamp fit one ledger; the any-of consumption and the unbounded bag do not, so take the shape and fix the toast anchor and per-tick pacing.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a pickup into a full stat leaves the world item and the ledger unchanged, and that a pickup filling one attribute but not another consumes the item only under the chosen rule; on a 375 px phone, five pickups in one frame show five toasts at 400 ms steps and the next set waits 2 s from the first toast.
